title: Lesson 39 perfective, imperfective, root-stock, and related patientive NNC review

groups.title: Perfective-patientive foundation and passive model
groups.proposal: Capture an exact owner-issued active preterit VNC Result, derive the perfective patientive from its typed perfective predicate, enforce the Canvas final-edge restriction and tli class automatically, and offer the passive model only for a transitive Source.
groups.readingJob: Show the exact active Source, perfective predicate, final edge, passive or impersonal model, noun class, Result, and reading.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses passive versus impersonal only when the transitive Source makes both possible; perfective shape and class are automatic.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not accept raw perfective-looking stems, copied Results, examples, formulas, or surfaces as authority.

groups.title: Impersonal-model perfective patientives
groups.proposal: Apply the impersonal model to exact transitive or intransitive perfective Sources while preserving reflexive, reciprocal, and projective object structure and the exceptional human tē to analogical tla history without treating visible prefixes or examples as authority.
groups.readingJob: Show Source valence, objects, perfective stem, retained or changed carrier, referent, class, compositional reading, and narrow lexical facts.
groups.decisionSplit: The application derives participant and carrier consequences; the user chooses only a genuine remaining analysis or lexical ambiguity.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer valence or referent from tē or tla, and do not turn lexical examples into productive routes.

groups.title: Compound Sources and narrow ownerhood families
groups.proposal: Preserve the exact compound VNC Source and internal relation through perfective patientive formation. Keep abundant-life and acquired-family huah readings as narrow typed lexical facts, and inherit their automatic boundaries without using them as a productive stem list.
groups.readingJob: Show embed, matrix, relation, participants, boundaries, perfective Result, ordinary productive reading, and any narrow ownerhood fact.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses only a genuine compound relation or unresolved reading; the application preserves structure and applies typed boundaries automatically.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not reconstruct compounds from surface strings, expose w deletion as a spelling switch, or let ownerhood examples gate the route.

groups.title: Imperfective patientives and passive model
groups.proposal: Derive imperfective patientives from exact typed Sources with the licensed model and class.
groups.readingJob: Show Source, model, boundary, class, Result, and meaning.
groups.decisionSplit: Expose only a genuinely available model choice.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not use examples or surfaces as authority.

groups.title: Impersonal-model imperfective patientives
groups.proposal: Preserve typed participants and Source structure through the imperfective impersonal model.
groups.readingJob: Show participants, Source, model, Result, and reading.
groups.decisionSplit: Expose only genuine ambiguity.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer structure from visible prefixes.

groups.title: Characteristic patientives foundation

groups.readingJob: Show Source, characteristic relation, state, Result, and meaning.
groups.decisionSplit: Expose only a genuinely open characteristic relation.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not let English meaning authorize grammar.

groups.title: Characteristic ownerhood contrasts

groups.readingJob: Show Source, ownerhood matrix, Result, and reading contrast.
groups.decisionSplit: Expose only genuine ownerhood ambiguity.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not merge analyses by translation.

groups.title: Organic-possession characteristic readings

groups.title: Root and stock patientive foundation

groups.controlPolicy: Do not turn chihua-l, ye, toca, displayed prefixes, copied Results, translations, or examples into general route authority.

groups.title: Possessive patientives with the short-a tlani type-three causative

groups.readingJob: Show the exact patientive Source, possessor-to-causee transfer, inherited object history, l-plus-tl boundary, voice continuations, causative type, Result, and reading.
groups.decisionSplit: Expose the typed short-a matrix and intended complement reading; derive the causative object, shuntline history, boundary, and nonactive continuations automatically.
groups.controlPolicy: Keep short-a tlani distinct from long-a tlani, preserve exact Result identity, and do not turn examples, formulas, surfaces, or translations into route authority.

groups.title: Patientive nounstems as incorporated objects
groups.proposal: Continue an exact patientive Result as the incorporated object of a separately typed short-a tlani, ih-tlani, or tem-o-a matrix.
groups.readingJob: Show the exact patientive Source, incorporated-object role, possessor-to-applicative-object transfer, matrix, valence, Result, and reading.
groups.decisionSplit: Expose the typed matrix and genuine intended reading; derive incorporation, possessor transfer, and valence automatically.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not continue from a nounstem string, gate the route by the three examples, or merge incorporation with the external possessor object.

groups.title: Life and heart embed contrast
